title: Van Device
description: The device-to-van binding. THE AUTHORIZATION ANCHOR. Q1.
x-never-client-written: No client writes this collection. Not the driver app, not the admin panel. The binding is created by the server inside a transaction. A client-writable binding would be a client-writable identity.

installId.description: The stable per-install uuid of the bound phone. NOT a per-launch value. A per-launch value would create a new binding on every launch.

boundBy.description: The driver code that claimed it.
